verse.text: When I was a child, I spoke and thought and reasoned as a child. But when I grew up, I put away childish things.

reflection: Growing into godly manhood isn't about age—it's about laying down the selfishness, excuses, and impulsiveness that once ran our lives so we can show up fully for our families. Every time you choose patience over a short fuse, or responsibility over convenience, you're putting away a childish thing and picking up the mantle of a leader your kids can trust. That daily trade-off, repeated over years, is what actually shapes a man your family can lean on.
